pesca_coleccion.cana.ayuda: Right-click to cast. Wait for the real bite (the bobber sinks hard) and right-click to strike: strike on a fake nibble and the fish gets scared.
pesca_coleccion.pesca.asustado: Too soon! The fish got scared
pesca_coleccion.pez.charalito.historia: Small enough to fit in a spoon. It shows up in any water and never runs out.
pesca_coleccion.pez.mojarra.historia: Everyone's first catch. It likes running water and the midday sun.
pesca_coleccion.pez.carpa.historia: Calm and greedy. It pulls hard for a while and then rests, as if thinking it over.
pesca_coleccion.pez.bagre.historia: It comes out at night to feed on the bottom. Its whiskers can feel even the bobber.
pesca_coleccion.pez.sardina.historia: It swims in huge schools that shine like a single coin underwater.
pesca_coleccion.pez.perca.historia: It hunts when the sun is low. Its orange fins give it away among the weeds.
pesca_coleccion.pez.lenguado.historia: It buries itself in the sand with only its eyes showing. Both are on the same side.
pesca_coleccion.pez.trucha_montana.histo: It lives in the icy water up high. It jumps to snatch insects out of the air.
pesca_coleccion.pez.trucha_arcoiris.hist: When it rains it rises to the surface and its pink stripe shines like a rainbow.
pesca_coleccion.pez.lucio.historia: It waits still among the plants and strikes all at once. Mind your fingers.
pesca_coleccion.pez.payaso.historia: It hides among anemones. It's tiny but won't be caught easily.
pesca_coleccion.pez.salmon_rojo.historia: It swims upriver at dawn, leaping waterfalls to return to where it was born.
pesca_coleccion.pez.pez_globo.historia: When scared it puffs up like a ball and the fight gets tight. Don't eat it!
pesca_coleccion.pez.pez_luna.historia: Round as a plate and colored like a sunset. It loves the sun by the shore.
pesca_coleccion.pez.pez_espada.historia: The fastest in the open sea. It slices the water with its sword and turns in an instant.
pesca_coleccion.pez.anguila_cueva.histor: It has never seen the sun. It twists from side to side in the dark water of caves.
pesca_coleccion.pez.pez_linterna.histori: It rises from the deep at night with little lights on its body. Its arrows fade before they arrive.
pesca_coleccion.pez.koi_cerezo.historia: It only lives in ponds under cherry trees. They say it brings good luck to whoever sets it free.
pesca_coleccion.pez.pirana.historia: It fights fast and furious. Once it bites, the arrows come in bursts.
pesca_coleccion.pez.pez_fantasma.histori: Transparent as mist. It only appears on rainy nights and you can barely see it.
pesca_coleccion.pez.esturion.historia: It has swum the rivers since before villages existed. It's huge and never tires.
pesca_coleccion.pez.pez_volador.historia: With the lightning it leaps out and glides on wing-like fins. You have to catch it in the air.
pesca_coleccion.pez.patriarca.historia: A giant catfish with golden whiskers. They say it only bites on full-moon nights.
pesca_coleccion.pez.dragon_jade.historia: It shines like a gemstone. It only appears when storm and dawn reach the jungle together.
pesca_coleccion.pez.celacanto.historia: A fish from before the dinosaurs, with scales like glass. It rises from the abyss on moonless nights.
